title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Novel Lightweight TaNbVTi-Based Refractory High Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by powder metallurgy method using high purity (>99.5 wt.%) Ta, Nb, V, Ti elemental powders in equiatomic composition, blended with planetary ball-millers for 6 h at 120 rpm under argon atmosphere at 25°C, then consolidated via SPS at 1700°C with a heating rate of 100°C/min, held for 10 min with a constant pressure of 30 MPa

title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Novel Lightweight TaNbVTi-Based Refractory High Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by powder metallurgy method using high purity (>99.5 wt.%) Ta, Nb, V, Ti elemental powders in equiatomic composition mixed with 10 vol.% Al2O3 powders, blended with planetary ball-millers for 6 h at 120 rpm under argon atmosphere at 25°C, then consolidated via SPS at 1700°C with a heating rate of 100°C/min, held for 10 min with a constant pressure of 30 MPa
